layout.scene: A game room with a rectangular board-game table between a shelving unit and the doorway. A window lines one side and a clear aisle lines the opposite side.
layout.public_intro: Inside a game room, a rectangular board-game table stands between a shelving unit and the doorway, with a window along one side.

establish.public_view: Wide establishing shot from the doorway end, looking lengthwise along the game table toward the shelving unit, with both window-side seats and the shelf-end seat in frame.

partial_pair.public_view: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

partial_first.public_view: Close-up from the aisle side, centered on the person in the shelf-side window seat.

partial_second.public_view: Close-up from the aisle side, centered on the person in the doorway-side window seat.

probe_reverse.public_view: Reverse wide shot from the shelving-unit end, looking lengthwise along the game table toward the doorway, with both window-side seats and the shelf-end seat in frame.

probe_overhead.public_view: Top-down wide shot from directly above the game table, centered on the tabletop, with both window-side seats and the shelf-end seat in frame.
